product.title: Paris City Center "the History of Paris" Exclusive Guided Walking Tour

description.text: Tick off some of Paris’ most iconic attractions, at your own pace, on this private walking tour of the City of Light. Alongside your personal guide, you’ll head to one of Paris’ oldest districts, Île de la Cité, and explore the pristine Tuileries Gardens. Stops include Ile de la Cite, Cathedrale Notre-Dame de Paris, Sainte-Chapelle, Pont Neuf, Louvre Museum, Jardin des Tuileries. Visit Place de la Concorde, home to the world’s first guillotine, admire the grandeur of Fontaine Saint-Michel, and delve into Paris’ turbulent history as you amble along the Champs-Elysees, the world-famous boulevard that flanks the River Seine. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
